package fixture

import "fmt"

// The flagged shape: the value lands between quotes the literal supplies, so
// nothing escapes it.
func bad(sha string) string {
	return `{"ref":"refs/heads/main","after":"` + sha + `"}`
}

// Not flagged: the value has its own slot, no quotes around it.
func ok(fragment string) string {
	return `{"conclusion":` + fragment + `}`
}

// Not flagged: not JSON.
func notJSON(name string) string {
	return "assets/" + name + ".js"
}

var _ = fmt.Sprint
